collection.description: A pregnant father finds that his work clothes pinch and pull.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a pregnant father, finds that his work clothes pinch and pull. He likes some changes and dislikes others, and he wants to remain comfortable without surrendering his own style.

text_only.reason: a feeling in the moment, not a lasting dislike -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: He makes a sturdy tunic that fits well and feels like him.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The first seams split when he bends, and he starts again.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Together they make clothing suited to his work and body.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The tailor assumes he wants a different style; he corrects them.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A change of routine reduces his discomfort.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: He misses a favorite task and negotiates a different role.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The friend listens without deciding how he should feel.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The friend tries to reassure him too quickly and learns to listen.
